title: Preflight Policy Decision
description: The deterministic, machine-readable verdict the server-authoritative verifier returns for an Action Intent + Evidence Bundle under a named policy. The three decisions map to the local kernel's tiers: ALLOW=AUTO, REQUIRE_APPROVAL=CONFIRM, BLOCK=BLOCK. Any error, missing/stale/forged/contradictory evidence yields BLOCK (fail-closed).

decision.description: The verdict. ALLOW: evidence authorizes the action. REQUIRE_APPROVAL: valid but the policy demands a human. BLOCK: denied or unverifiable.

policyId.description: Identifier of the policy that produced this decision.

intentId.description: The Action Intent this decision is for. 'unknown' when the intent could not be parsed (still a BLOCK).

evaluatedAt.description: RFC3339 UTC reference time used for the decision (the injected 'now'), echoed for auditability and determinism.

reasons.description: Sorted human-readable reason codes/notes explaining the decision (e.g. 'evidence:tests-pass:fresh', 'integrity:unauthenticated'). Sorted for byte-stable output.

violations.description: Sorted machine codes for each failed check driving a non-ALLOW decision (e.g. 'schema.invalid', 'hash.mismatch', 'freshness.stale', 'evidence.missing', 'contradiction.head', 'integrity.forged', 'dependency.unavailable'). Empty on ALLOW.

checks.description: The individual verification checks the verifier ran, in fixed order, each pass/fail. Makes the decision fully inspectable rather than a black box.
